title: Typed intro, skill words on tilted screens, desk pull-out
summary: A personal showcase: a caret types a greeting and a name on flat light grey, then each skill word cascades in beside a tilted screen of that work, and the profile page is pushed in, panned and pulled back onto a desk monitor.
use_when: A freelancer or creator introducing themselves and three to four skills
A portfolio reel built from screenshots rather than footage
A profile or cover-image showcase that needs to end on the full page in context
Voice-over intros where the type follows the speaker word by word

look.type_style: serif text face throughout: greeting and lead lines regular, small (~4 % H); name and skill words bold or semibold accent colour, wide letter-spacing caps for the first skill word (~6 % H), sentence case for later ones (~7 % H); each skill word has its own colour

sfx.event: each typed letter of the greeting and name lines
tilted screen rises from the bottom edge beside a skill word
hard cut onto the profile page
pull-out from the page to the desk monitor

structure.shot: flat light grey; a thin teal caret blinks left of centre, then a greeting line types out and runs on into a half sentence
structure.camera: locked frame, no camera move; the whole line slides left as it grows so the caret stays near centre-right
structure.motion: caret alone 0.27-1.00 s; typing ~10 chars/s (±0.25 s); line slides left on easings.linear while typing; line clears by 2.27 s

structure.shot: small 3-word label + the person's name typed letter by letter in bold teal caps; whole line fades, name returns as a small plain dark word and holds
structure.camera: locked frame, no camera move; line slides left ~2 % per cell as letters append
structure.motion: name typed ~4 letters/s (one letter per 0.25 s cell); fade out 3.00-3.27 s, ~8 fr (±0.25 s); plain name fades in by 3.50 s and holds 1.5 s

structure.shot: 3-word lead phrase types top left; skill word 1 in spaced teal caps with a swash underline; tilted profile-page screenshot, then a photo collage, rise at right
structure.camera: locked frame; the tilted screenshot travels up ~340-400 px/s at 1920 (motion.json s6-7) and grows ~12 %/s
structure.motion: lead words type in 5.00-5.50 s; skill word + swash at 5.77 s; screenshot enters from right edge on easings.outExpo ~10 fr (±0.25 s); lead line fades by 6.77 s; skill word recolours teal to grey to coral 7.00-7.77 s

structure.shot: empty grey 1.3 s; 2-word aside appears, then 3-word lead in teal; skill word 2 cascades in letter by letter in blue beside a tilted dark editor screen rising from bottom left
structure.camera: locked frame; dark screen tilted ~-5 degrees rises from the bottom edge, ~110 px/s at 1920 (motion.json s11)
structure.motion: aside words step in 9.50 s, offset baselines; lead at 10.00 s; skill letters drop in on a diagonal, ~2 letters per cell (stagger ~4 fr, ±0.25 s); lead text fades by 10.77 s; next skill word starts to cascade under it at 11.77 s

structure.shot: skill word 3 (green) cascades beside a tilted light browser screenshot; at 13.00 s skill word 4 (coral) with five floating app icons beside a tilted dark node-graph screen
structure.camera: locked frame; each screen rises from the bottom edge and settles tilted ~-5 degrees, ~100-190 px/s at 1920 (motion.json s12, s14)
structure.motion: letter cascade as row 4; previous screen exits up and out of frame as the next rises; icons drift ~10 px/cell; skill word 3 fades 13.00 s; springs.ui settle (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: tilted light window with an agent prompt and a working status list rises; then 2-line closing claim (dark + teal accent) right, six tool logos scattered left
structure.camera: locked frame; window rises ~190 px/s at 1920 then exits up by 15.77 s
structure.motion: window rise 14.83-15.27 s on easings.outExpo (±0.25 s); claim lines in at 15.77 s; logos drift outward and off the frame 16.00-16.97 s, easings.inExpo (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: full profile page: wide cover banner with tool logos and portrait, avatar and the name typing in letter by letter, follower and bio lines under it
structure.camera: push-in 1.00 -> ~2.0 over 84 fr toward the name and the banner tagline, accelerating (motion.json zoom 17 to 72 %/s), drifting up-left
structure.motion: name types ~2 letters per cell (±0.25 s); push-in easings.inOutSine (suggested), speed rises across the row

structure.shot: close crop on the banner tagline and the name block; camera travels across the banner to the portrait and the contact block
structure.camera: dolly up-right across the banner, ~450-700 px/s at 1920 (motion.json s20), scale ~2.0 held
structure.motion: dolly easings.inOutSine 56 fr (suggested curve); settles on the portrait by 20.77 s, slow drift after

structure.shot: banner at portrait crop, then the whole cover page with a skills ticker strip under it comes into view
structure.motion: pull-out springs.cameraOut (overshoot not measurable); a cursor arrow sits on the page

structure.shot: the page becomes the screen of a desktop monitor on a desk with blue backlight, plant and keyboard; 3 icon + verb rows appear right of the monitor
structure.camera: pull-out continues ~-27 to -10 %/s, monitor shrinks to ~50 % W by 26.50 s; slight drift left
structure.motion: monitor frame dark edge in at 23.50 s; verb rows appear 24.50 s small and grow with the camera, then enlarge to ~4 % H by 26.50 s (±0.25 s); decelerating, easings.outQuint (suggested)

structure.shot: empty flat light grey hold to the end

params.brand: brand.json: serif display font, fg, accent (name, lead lines), bg light grey
params.content.greeting: 1 greeting line typed with a caret, 3-5 words
params.content.label: small 3-word label before the name
params.content.name: the person's name, typed in accent caps
params.content.skills: 3-4 skill words, one word each, each with its own colour and one screenshot
params.content.leads: short lead phrases before skill words, 2-3 words each
params.content.claim: 2-line closing claim, second line in the accent
params.content.toolLogos: 4-8 tool logos that scatter around the claim
params.content.profileImage: full-page profile or cover screenshot, used for the push-in, dolly and desk pull-out
params.content.verbs: 3 icon + verb rows next to the desk monitor
params.timing.typeCps: typing speed (default ~10 chars/s for the greeting, ~4 letters/s for the name)

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); no 30 fps strip. Rows 1-3 are one shot (0-7.93 s), split at the state changes 2.27 s and 5.00 s; rows 9-10 are one shot split at 23.50 s when the monitor frame appears. Cut_on_beat 2/7. Whisper says VO is present (heuristic disagreed); ~42 words over 28.7 s (~1.5 words/s) and the on-screen words follow the VO. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured: the mix is music + VO. Spring and easing names, screen tilt and letter stagger are suggested, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): letter-cascade, swash-underline, desk-monitor-pullout. The blank 1.3 s at 7.93 s and the 2 s empty tail are in the reference; trim them in a remake if there is no VO to carry them.
